title: Penalty.
bodyText: Any person, or agent, or officer thereof, who violates this chapter is punishable by a fine of not more than $1,000 or imprisonment of not more than one year, or both.
bodyHtml: §379-4  Penalty.  Any person, or agent, or officer thereof, who violates this chapter is punishable by a fine of not more than $1,000 or imprisonment of not more than one year, or both. [L 1967, c 18, pt of §2; HRS §379-4]
